components.description: Controls approved coding agents, versions, and ownership.

components.name: Workflow definitions
components.description: Defines reproducible single-agent and multi-agent workflows.

components.name: Agent orchestration runtime
components.description: Coordinates agent turns, handoffs, state, and cancellation.

components.name: Model gateway
components.description: Provides a governed model invocation boundary.

components.name: Model catalog
components.description: Records approved models, providers, regions, and constraints.

components.description: Selects eligible models using declared policy and economics.

components.name: Connector registry
components.description: Catalogs approved tools, APIs, schemas, and owners.

components.description: Connects issues, repositories, branches, reviews, and merges.

components.name: Approved package access
components.description: Restricts dependency retrieval to governed registries.

components.name: Enterprise API access
components.description: Connects approved enterprise systems with scoped credentials.

components.name: Execution broker
components.description: Places tasks onto eligible local or remote runtimes.

components.name: Managed local runtime
components.description: Runs interactive coding agents on governed developer endpoints.

components.name: Ephemeral task runtime
components.description: Runs isolated asynchronous tasks in short-lived environments.

components.name: Persistent developer workspace
components.description: Supports long migrations and durable development environments.

components.name: Self-hosted container runtime
components.description: Runs coding-agent tasks on customer-operated container compute.

components.name: Self-hosted Kubernetes runtime
components.description: Runs coding-agent tasks on a customer-operated Kubernetes platform.

components.name: Policy engine
components.description: Evaluates tool, model, data, network, and approval policy.

components.name: Secrets broker
components.description: Issues short-lived credentials to approved agent actions.

components.name: Decision and action ledger
components.description: Preserves replayable requirements, decisions, and agent actions.

components.name: Quota and budget manager
components.description: Enforces team concurrency, usage, and economic limits.

components.name: Agent telemetry pipeline
components.description: Collects model, tool, runtime, and policy traces.

components.name: Evaluation service
components.description: Measures task quality, safety, and regression behavior.

components.name: Token and platform economics
components.description: Attributes model and platform cost to successful outcomes.

components.name: Outcome correlator
components.description: Joins agent traces to source-control and CI results.

components.name: Architecture intelligence catalog
components.description: Stores versioned patterns, components, rules, and controls.

components.name: Evidence claim catalog
components.description: Connects reviewed claims to immutable source snapshots.

components.name: Multi-agent supervisor
components.description: Coordinates specialist workers and independent review.

components.name: Model-provider fallback
components.description: Applies bounded fallback among eligible model providers.

components.name: Private connectivity
components.description: Keeps eligible model, tool, and runtime traffic on private paths.

components.name: Risk-based human approval
components.description: Requires approval at declared high-impact transaction boundaries.

components.name: Restricted runtime egress
components.description: Allows runtimes to reach only approved destinations.

components.name: Multi-region resilience
components.description: Adds region-aware routing, failover, and evidence.

components.name: Sequential specialist handoff
components.description: Passes bounded work products between specialist agents with explicit state and completion criteria.

components.name: Parallel candidates with independent review
components.description: Runs independent candidate agents and routes their results through a separate reviewer.

components.name: Static multi-model binding
components.description: Pins approved models to declared agent roles without request-time model selection.

components.name: Warm pools and resumable snapshots
components.description: Maintains pre-initialized or resumable execution capacity for startup-latency objectives.
